**How you expected it to resolve, and why**
If this is a place Chudopoly departs from Monopoly Deal, it may well be deliberate — several
departures are recorded with their reasoning in ARCHITECTURE.md §3. Worth a look first, though

**Does the help screen say anything about it?**
No rule is allowed to exist that the in-game help does not state, so if the help is silent that
is a bug on its own.
